question: The current Secretary General of United Nations Antonio Guterres belongs to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Portugal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonio Guterres** is the current Secretary General of the United Nations.
 
• He belongs to **Portugal**.
 
• Antonio Guterres took office on **January 1, 2017**, succeeding Ban Ki-moon.
 
• He was re-elected for a second term, which commenced on **January 1, 2022**.
 
• Before his tenure as Secretary General, Guterres served as the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees from 2005 to 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **United Nations** was founded in 1945 after the end of World War II to prevent future wars and conflicts.
 
• It is an international organization comprising **193 member states**.
 
• The **Secretary General** is the head of the United Nations Secretariat, one of the principal organs of the UN.
 
• The role of the Secretary General includes **administrative functions** and acting as a **spokesperson and leader** of the organization.
 
• Antonio Guterres has focused on **reforming the UN** to make it more efficient and effective, addressing global challenges like climate change, humanitarian crises, and sustainable development.
